verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Linear's own dashboards or widgets for reporting on project progress. The one dashboard mention comes from the integrations directory, which lists third-party apps, and Fivetran/Airbyte syncs and shareable filtered views are only adjacent data-export or view features. None of this is first-party dashboard or widget building.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
